## Compensation — field (Co)

A pay package as one value so every surface renders pay one way and a change can be recorded whole. Computed `summary` gives list rows a one-liner. Domain-neutral: no approval or effective-date semantics — those belong to the record card that contains it (see the Compensation card).

### Non-goals

No currency conversion (plain USD-denominated numbers). No payroll math — this states the package, it does not run it.
